messages:
Noah (Marketing): Quick check-in for release day ops — we want to publish the launch blog T-24 with the canonical docs and a conservative benchmark blurb. Need engineering to confirm changelog merge window and the final prod docs URL. Ivy, you available? :calendar:
Ivy (Engineering): Yep. Changelog PR #1123 is ready but holding on a final canary perf run. If canary looks stable I can merge and trigger the docs publish in ~3h.
Devin (Product): Marketing: please don't link a PR. We need a stable path like /docs/releases/2026-03-accelerate. Rita, can you stage and give us a staging URL to check asset rendering?
Rita (DevEx): Starting docs staging build now. Pushing to staging URL; will run CDN invalidation. Deploy job: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/doc-3488.
deploy-bot: docs staging deploy started (job id: doc-3488) — logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/3488
Rita (DevEx): Staging preview: https://staging.redwood.com/docs/releases/2026-03-accelerate. All images inline; note one code snippet needed escaping — I'll patch before prod.
Noah (Marketing): Good. Ivy, bench narrative you suggested was "~2x throughput on common text-gen paths (see benchmark notes)". We'll link a sanitized public bench page. Can you post the public bench URL when ready?
Ivy (Engineering): Will sanitize and publish. Internal report at https://bench.redwood.internal/reports/rel-2026-03. Public summary will be at https://bench.redwood.com/public/release-2026-03-accelerate. I'll paste it here before EOD. Also: recommend we avoid a single latency stat in the post and instead link to the harness for details.
Devin (Product): Webinar follow-up: schedule for Apr 12. Marketing to collect registrants; HubSpot should tag them with "launch-2026-03" and add to nurture list "accelerate-webinar". Rita, can you add a webhook that only tags the landing-page signups?
Rita (DevEx): Yup. I'll create a webhook scoped to landing_page_id and add retry/backoff. Example snippet added to the automation runbook: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.hubspot.com/contacts/v1/contact -H "Authorization: Bearer $HUBSPOT" -d '{"properties":[{"property":"hs_tags","value":"launch-2026-03"}]}'
```
Noah (Marketing): Go checklist: 1) Merge changelog PR 2) Prod docs live 3) Public bench summary URL in thread 4) Blog scheduled + social copy ready 5) HubSpot webhook active. React with :white_check_mark: when each done.
Ivy (Engineering): Canary perf green, merging PR #1123 now. Will kick release job after merge. :white_check_mark: (1735013800)
deploy-bot: release job started - id: release-9921.
Rita (DevEx): Pushed prod docs at https://www.redwood.com/docs/releases/2026-03-accelerate. CDN edge propagation ~6m. Fixed the code snippet escaping. :white_check_mark: (1735014360)
Ivy (Engineering): Public bench summary published: https://bench.redwood.com/public/release-2026-03-accelerate-summary. Use wording: "~2x throughput improvement on common text-generation workloads (see benchmark notes)."
Devin (Product): Notion draft updated with final links and webinar details: https://notion.redwood.com/p/launch-2026-03-accelerate. Webinar scheduled; HubSpot test run applied the tag correctly.
Noah (Marketing): Excellent. Scheduling announcement for T-24h with those links. Quick reminder: when you post the blog, include the changelog path at /docs/releases/2026-03-accelerate/changelog.md and the bench link above. If anything regresses, ping immediately. :rocket:
